create_LanguageModelAnnotator: create a LanguageModelAnnotator that uses an LLM to annotate pairs of game subepisodes based on messages or blstats
build_ReturnAnnotator: build a ReturnAnnotator that compares two subepisodes by summing their reward arrays and picking the higher return
build_ScoreAnnotator: build a ScoreAnnotator that compares two subepisodes by selecting the one with the higher score value
create_RandomAnnotator: create a RandomAnnotator that returns random annotations choosing uniformly from first, second, or tie
review_Annotator: review the Annotator abstract base class defining the call interface, data_keys, info_keys, and transform properties
